title: You can see your next fest stats on steamworks !
author: maxlopezos
selftext:
I just realised steam shows your exact steam next fest event recap on steamworks, that's pretty cool! Please share your stats under this post so we can see how it went for everybody !

It made me realise a lot of people actually played my demo without wishlisting which sucks but also maybe those are players that wishlisted before the event started as i had some good traction even before that.

btw i used ai for troubleshooting and performance optimisation if you guys are curious :

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5064170/Go\_Next/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5064170/Go_Next/)
